root_cause.text: The compat_mtw_from_user function in the ebtables subsystem lacks validation to ensure the user-supplied match or target size meets the extension's required compatsize, allowing out-of-bounds reads when compat_from_user callbacks access memory based on the expected size.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states the function "lacks proper validation of the user-supplied match_size/target_size" and that "->compat_from_user() callbacks assume they can read compatsize bytes," while the patch introduces match_size_ok and tgt_size_ok checks enforcing match_size >= csize before processing.
